data.text:
Heavy rain from former tropical storm “Bualoi” since September 28 has caused flooding and landslides in 18 provinces, affecting 16,740 households (60,294 people). Seven people have died: one woman in Mae Hong Son (landslide), one man in Khon Kaen (drowned while clearing a drain), three men and one woman swept away by floodwaters, and one man in Uttaradit (motorcycle accident in flood). Three people remain missing in Uttaradit.

Flooding continues in Uttaradit and Loei, affecting 7,443 households (27,539 people).

Another tropical storm, “Matmo,” is approaching the Philippines. It was centered east of the country this morning, moving northwest. The storm is expected to cross Luzon and enter the upper South China Sea later today before heading toward Hainan and making landfall in southern China during October 5–6.

The storm will not directly enter Thailand, but weakening rainbands may cover the northern region and the upper Northeast. The southwest monsoon is also expected to strengthen during October 6–7.
